notes: New: train on your phone. Open codesieb.github.io/freechess-releases/m, enter your restore code once, and do your Memory cards, notes and puzzles. It all comes back to the add-on automatically.
New: Notebook (Learn → Notebook). Save any position from analysis, reviews, puzzles or Play Coach with your own note and tags, review them now and then, and download them as PGN.
Send 5 puzzles: share a link with your last 5 solved puzzles. Friends play them on their phone or computer, no account needed.
Share your progress as a picture (Progress).
30-day challenge on Home: train on 20 of 30 days, with new achievements. Set a daily reminder right there; it tells you what is left of today's plan.
